_comment: Parts factory pilot 1 (FACTORY_WORKFLOW v0.1, author 6. 10. 2026): the corridor frame module - portal ring, its foot lights and the floor plates between two portals. Step 2 drawing data, read by Tools/Design/draw_part_sheet.py. Lengths in metres in the layout frame (x along the run, y across, z up from the deck); the profile detail in millimetres. Sections from ArtSource/Kit/kit_rules.json.
title: Rámový modul chodby – portál, patky se světlem, podlahová deska
status: rev. E ke schválení (tvar rámu a boty; krok 5 detail)

profile._comment: Cross-section of the ring member, u along the run (0..300 mm), v from the wall panel face into the corridor (0 = panel face, + = into the room). Steps: the base, step 2, the crown; a polished lip on the crown's edges, the ribbed cuff in the crown's middle; the hidden strip behind step 2 on the top member only.

lip._comment: rev. E: the crown's 45 deg facet (18 x 18 mm) polished - one light line from each side

cuff._comment: rev. D: finer ribs (4 on a 9 mm pitch, 2 mm high), the rubber a tone lighter (kit_materials rubber 0.04): no dark stripe in the middle of the frame

protrusion_by_section._N: N: step 2 and the crown 10 mm shallower each (base 0-40, step 40-60, crown 60-80)

hidden_strip._comment: rev. B: two symmetric strips, each at the top of a 14 x 20 mm groove in step 2's ledge, against the crown's riser (rev. A: one strip on the ledge face, u 46-58, seen from the near side)

profile._solid: rev. C: the three steps are one solid shape in one lacquer, no seams between them - they read only by shadow and highlight

profile_half._comment: rev. E: the member's cross-section from the wall side to the middle (u mm along the run, v mm out of the wall), mirrored at u 150; each riser a 45 deg facet with a short vertical foot, the treads 5-6 mm (the worn edges); the crown's facet is the polished lip. Roles per edge to the next point.

lights.name: bota – kalich
lights.housing: osmiboká jamka 70 mm, hl. 60 (N 45) v ploché botě 150 mm; tmavé dno, zdroj Ø14
lights.reach: 0,05 cd: svítí stěny kalichu; rozptyl na podlahu slabý (otevřené)

lights.name: horní roh
lights.where: W z 2,10 m, N z 2,10 m

lights.name: skrytá lišta
lights.housing: lišta pod horním členem; místo drážky po rev. E otevřené

floor._comment: rev. B: the kit floor's character (kit_batch3.py: anti-slip lanes on the walkway, smooth bolted side plates, edge strips, the grille over a deep channel) with the SC principles only: a polished lip 18 mm round the walkway plate, its lane field sunk 6 mm, chamfered corners. Not the Aurora's perforated plate.

grille._what: variant G: the grille over a deep service channel along the run (Floor_Grille)

floor._network: rev. C: one continuous network of the polished lip over every plate - the walkway plates, the corner triangles by their chamfers, the side plates, the band and the threshold under the portal: the floor reads as one system, not mats laid on it

threshold._comment: The floor inside the portal module: a plain tread plate 0.3 m with the lip, the foot light housings at its ends.

revisions.what: pohled z oka v roztečích 1,2 a 2,4 m; podlaha s charakterem kitu (protiskluzové pásy, hluboká mřížka) + lem 18 mm, vložka −6 mm, zkosené rohy; sokl bez holé modré lišty (pryžový kopací pás); L3 dvě symetrické lišty v drážce, ověřená viditelnost; destička pásu se 4 šrouby; rám celý krémový lak

rám jeden plný lakovaný tvar bez spár mezi stupni, leštěný lem jen na hraně koruny (jedna linka), pryžová manžeta na vnitřní straně; patka L1 jako osmiboká bota kolem paty pilíře, vrostlá do podlahy, světlo zapuštěné uvnitř; souvislá síť leštěného lemu přes všechny desky, práh, boční desky a pás

bota L1 světlá v laku rámu s leštěnou hranou nahoře, světlo jako záře uvnitř osmibokého kalichu (svítící dno + slabé světlo s dosahem ~0,5 m), žádný reflektor; v N menší bota (120 mm) kvůli průchodu; manžeta jemnější (žebra 4 / 9, výška 2) a guma o tón světlejší

čela stupňů rámu zkosená pod 45° (chytají světlo, ne stín), leštěná je zkosená hrana koruny; bota L1 nižší (W 150, N 120 mm), osmiboká i v půdorysu, plochá bez stříšky, s leštěnou hranou; kalich hluboký 60 mm, svítí jeho vnitřní stěny, zdroj jen malý bod Ø14

plinth.choice: pryžový kopací pás 100 mm bez světla
plinth.why: etalon SC nemá souvislou světelnou lištu u podlahy: orientační světlo dávají patky L1 (ostrůvky po rozteči), holý emisivní pruh porušuje pravidlo světla v pouzdře; pryž doplní materiálovou trojici a chrání sokl
plinth.alternative: lišta s opálovým difuzorem 20 mm v drážce 30 mm pod přesahem 10 mm (zdroj skrytý), kdyby autor chtěl souvislou linku

boot._comment: rev. E: the L1 boot round the pillar's foot - light lacquer, a polished bead on its top edge, octagonal in plan (the corridor-side vertical edges chamfered 50 mm), flat on top with no roof (the pillar rises out of it); W 150 mm high, N 120 mm (in proportion); the cup sunk 60 mm (W) / 45 mm (N) into its corridor face, an octagon 70 mm across: its inner walls lit by a weak point light, the source a small bright point (a 14 mm emitter at the bottom); ~7500 K, no spot.

cup._light: round 2 (6. 10.): 0.6 cd a few cm from the walls burnt the well to a flat white octagon; 0.05 cd near the dark bottom - the walls bright at the bottom, falling off to the rim

light_levels._comment: rev. C calibration (Docs/Reviews/2026-10-06_kit_test_section_revc.md); L1 rev. D: the cup's weak point light

details._comment: Step 5 detail (6. 10. 2026) from the etalon card and the Halcyon style: labels small in a hierarchy, relief instead of big decals, no screws on the lacquer.

pillar_label._what: a 3 cm frame number on the base facet of each pillar (etalon: 3 cm labels on the pillar's side)

threshold._what: the threshold as the band: 5 grooves across, a cover plate 400 x 150 with 4 bolts (a functional cover), the maker's badge in relief on it

gutter._what: the edge strip by the plinth with 3 grooves along the run (the etalon's gutter)

grime._what: dirt where it forms: rim cards round the boot's foot, smears in the threshold's corners by the walls, along the gutter; the walked line and the seams through the material
